title: Shortest Path in a Hidden Grid
summary: Explore an unknown grid through a GridMaster interface (canMove, move, isTarget) and return the minimum number of steps from the start to the target, or -1 if the target is unreachable. The map can only be discovered by moving; exploration must track relative positions and backtrack.
inputFormat: No input grid: the GridMaster interface is the input.
edgeRules: Whether the start may be the target, and the grid size and call limit, are not recorded.
factsMissing: Exact return semantics of canMove, move and isTarget
Whether the start cell can be the target
questions: What exactly do canMove(direction), move(direction) and isTarget() return, including when a move enters the target or a blocked cell?
What are the maximum grid dimensions and the call limit?
